entities.name: SI-BF
aliases: substantia innominata of the basal forebrain

relationships.subject: PBel CGRP neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Blocking PBel<sup>CGRP</sup> neurons with genetic ablation or optogenetic inhibition attenuated sleep loss.

relationships.subject: BIBN4096BS
relationships.evidence_quote: BIBN injections (CGRP antagonist) recovered AIP‐induced sleep loss in the SI‐BF implanted mice by 97.4%, and 93.8% in the CeA implanted mice in the 3–6 h period post‐injection.

relationships.subject: AP-5
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that the NMDA receptor blocker (AP‐5) effects were comparable to the BIBN at both injection sites during the 1–3 h and 3–6 h periods post‐injection.

key_findings: PBelCGRP neurons relay nociceptive input to cause arousal; silencing terminals in SI-BF and CeA most effectively reversed AIP sleep loss.
Local CGRP receptor (BIBN) or NMDA receptor (AP-5) blockade in SI-BF/CeA reversed pain-induced sleep loss.
